hero.headline: Every action has a boundary.
hero.body: AI can plan the work. Audoryn decides whether an external action is allowed, must wait for a person, or must stop.

decision.headline: Three possible answers. None of them decided by the model.
decision.body: Choose a decision to see what happens to the same request.

checks.label: Agent identity
checks.detail: The worker and its organization are confirmed

checks.label: Declared capability
checks.detail: The operation matches a granted scope

checks.label: Risk and current policy
checks.detail: Current conditions and the deterministic rule

allow.label: Allow
allow.title: The action may proceed.
allow.body: A permitted request reaches the provider only after the current identity, capability, risk and policy checks pass.
allow.note: Only an allowed request can call the provider.

review.label: Require approval
review.title: The action waits for a person.
review.body: The run pauses and an authorized reviewer receives the request. Before an approved action resumes, Audoryn checks its authority again.
review.note: Approval is bound to the exact requested action.

deny.label: Deny
deny.title: The action stops here.
deny.body: A denied request is blocked at the gateway. The connected provider is never called for that action.
deny.note: Missing or uncertain authority fails closed.

record.summary: The request, each check, the decision and the result share one correlation reference.

controlPath.headline: A connected tool does not grant permission to use it.
controlPath.body: Each request passes explicit checks before it reaches an external system. AI instructions and memory give context; they never become authority.

steps.label: Who
steps.title: Identity
steps.body: Confirm the worker and its organization.

steps.label: What
steps.title: Capability
steps.body: Match the requested operation to a declared scope.

steps.label: Now
steps.title: Risk and policy
steps.body: Evaluate current conditions against the deterministic rule.

steps.label: Outcome
steps.title: Act, wait or stop
steps.body: Allow, require human approval, or deny.

safeguards.headline: Control continues after a decision.
safeguards.body: Authority can change while work is underway. Audoryn keeps the relevant checks and the human response in the execution path.

items.title: Distinct identities
items.body: A person's session cannot act as an AI worker. Every managed worker has its own agent identity, and organization boundaries are checked.

items.title: Protected credentials
items.body: Connected provider credentials stay inside the backend credential boundary. Models never receive provider tokens or direct provider tools.

items.title: Human intervention
items.body: Sensitive actions can wait for review. An organization, worker or integration can be suspended without deleting its configuration.

items.title: A record to inspect
items.body: Requests, decisions, approvals and provider outcomes carry correlation context, so operators can follow what happened.

record.headline: What happened, who acted and why.
record.body: Every decision leaves an entry that connects the request, the rule that applied and the result.

records.action: Read issues in the product repository

records.policy: Destructive repository actions are not granted

closing.headline: Useful autonomy needs clear authority.
closing.body: See how these controls fit into the product, then start with a worker and a defined job.
